notes: /configuration/2 says startIcon shows "ic_rupee by default". The evidence gives ic_rupee only as the default of the Figma startIcon property. The guide says only "The rupee icon", and nothing cited shows which icon the package renders when startIcon is set without leadingIconName. A human should check this against the package types. /configuration/4 recommends a Coin Button in trailing, which the evidence supports, but the published Storybook story uses a plain Pressable "Apply" instead.
